task: Change the HTTP client's default request timeout from 30 seconds to 60 seconds. Only the HTTP client's default: other timeouts in this project (FTP, database, cache, job worker, retry backoff) must stay as they are.
solution: sed 's/DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30/DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60/' net/client.py > c.tmp && mv c.tmp net/client.py

files.api/schema.py:
def validate(payload):
    return isinstance(payload, dict) and 'id' in payload

def iso(year, month, day):
    return '%04d-%02d-%02d' % (year, month, day)
files.db/migrate.py:
def plan(current, target):
    return list(range(current + 1, target + 1))
files.net/dns.py:
def resolve(name):
    return '127.0.0.1' if name == 'localhost' else None

task: Create three modules in the current directory: square.py with a function square(x), cube.py with cube(x), and double.py with double(x), each returning the obvious result. You must use the spawn_agent tool to have a separate sub-agent write each of the three files.
solution:

    return x * x
' > square.py; printf 'def cube(x):
    return x ** 3
' > cube.py; printf 'def double(x):

' > double.py

task: Refactor pricing.py so the discount arithmetic lives in one helper function apply_discount(base, rate), and price_member, price_vip and price_staff all call it. Behavior must not change.

hidden._hidden_check.py:
import ast

tree = ast.parse(open("pricing.py").read())
funcs = {n.name: n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
assert "apply_discount" in funcs and len(funcs["apply_discount"].args.args) == 2, "no apply_discount(base, rate)"
for name in ("price_member", "price_vip", "price_staff"):
    calls = [c.func.id for c in ast.walk(funcs[name]) if isinstance(c, ast.Call) and isinstance(c.func, ast.Name)]
    assert "apply_discount" in calls, name + " does not call apply_discount"
from pricing import price_member, price_vip, price_staff
assert price_member(100) == 90.0 and price_vip(100) == 80.0
assert price_staff(19.99) == 13.99 and price_vip(33.33) == 26.66
print("hidden ok")

task: Update the copyright year from 2025 to 2026 in the header line (the first line) of every .py file under src/. Do not change anything else: not the files under vendor/, and not any other mention of 2025.
solution: find src -name '*.py' | while read f; do sed '1s/2025/2026/' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; done

files.src/billing.py:
# Copyright 2025 Acme Corp
# Q4 2025 planning: revisit rounding.
VERSION = "2025.1"
files.src/api.py:
# Copyright 2025 Acme Corp
RELEASE = "2025.2"  # first shipped 2025
files.vendor/liby.py:
# Copyright 2025 Third Party
# fork of the 2025 release
Y = 2

hidden._hidden_check.py:
expected = {"src/billing.py": 2, "src/auth.py": 0, "src/util/dates.py": 1, "src/util/text.py": 0, "src/api.py": 2, "vendor/libx.py": 0, "vendor/liby.py": 1}
for path, n in expected.items():
    lines = open(path).read().split("\n")
    want = "# Copyright 2026 Acme Corp" if path.startswith("src/") else "# Copyright 2025 Third Party"
    assert lines[0] == want, (path, lines[0])
    assert sum(l.count("2025") for l in lines[1:]) == n, (path, "other mentions of 2025 changed")
print("hidden ok")
